title: BLOCK_RECORD XDATA write and dependency-closure fast slice
scope: Verify the concrete adapter transfers imported BLOCK_RECORD XDATA into the pending DXF writer record
Verify ordered typed XDATA and code-1005 source-handle remapping in ASCII and Binary AC1021 output
Verify missing-APPID refusal preserves the destination and supports corrected retry on the same writer

method.limitations: The source and both outputs are handled by this libdxfrw checkout. The generated controls prove local adapter/writer/refusal/readback behavior and handle closure, not independent-producer conformance or native application acceptance.

implementation.behavior: The concrete adapter forwards DRW_Block_Record XDATA. The writer owns a pending copy, validates required APPIDs before output publication, emits the ordered XDATA values, and remaps code-1005 references through the source-to-output entity map.
positiveControls: Existing BLOCK_RECORD preview fixture is augmented in memory with two APPIDs and ordered groups 1001, 1000, 1005, 1001, and 1010/1020/1030.
Code 1005 points to a LINE inside PREVIEW_BLOCK; output readback compares it with the actual emitted LINE handle.
AC1021 ASCII and Binary exports both preserve XDATA order and typed values.
A following SENTINEL_BLOCK retains its own empty XDATA and both block-body LINE sentinels survive.
negativeControls: Removing a required APPID makes output fail before replacing a destination sentinel.
Restoring the APPID allows a successful retry on the same writer instance.
